caption: The drawing depicts a circular tray with an elaborate, decorative border that features symmetrical, scroll-like patterns and floral motifs extending outward from the main edge at regular intervals. The design is rendered in shades of grey and black using pencil on a cream-colored paper background. The tray itself is shaded to indicate a reflective or metallic surface, while the ornate border is drawn with detailed line work to show three-dimensional relief. At the center of the tray, there are faint, cursive initials inscribed, which appear to be "ML." A thin, rectangular border encloses the entire composition, and a small scale in inches is present at the bottom right corner for reference.
title: Silver Salver
